title: Extensionality on iterated sheafified pure tensors
statement: Let D be a small category with topology K and a sheaf S of commutative rings. Use the existing module sheaves and pureTensor of [def-sf-twisted-action-presentation-data]. For S-module sheaves M,N,T,H, maps f,g from (M tensor N) tensor T to H are equal if, for every object X and sections x,y,z of M,N,T over X, their components agree on pureTensor(M tensor N,T,X,pureTensor(M,N,X,x,y),z). This is local generation after sheafification and requires no global generation hypothesis.

source.place: Tags 03EK and 03EL: module sheaf tensor, sheafification and unit coherence.

proof.text: Let E be the presheaf tensor M.val tensor N.val. Its sheafification unit is a local equivalence. Tensor it with the identity of T.val and sheafify: tensor preserves local equivalences, so the resulting map is invertible. Compose with tensorObjIsoSheafification inverses and tensor the inner comparison inverse with the identity. This gives an invertible map to (M tensor N) tensor T.

source.place: Tags 03EK and 03EL: module sheaf tensor, sheafification and unit coherence.

proof.text: Naturality of the sheafification unit and the proved pure_map formula show that this invertible map sends each ordinary pure triple to the displayed nested sheafified pure tensor.

proof.text: Cancel the invertible map and apply the sheafification adjunction hom-equivalence. Presheaf morphism extensionality and ModuleCat tensor_ext₃-prime reduce equality to pure triples. The preceding formula and the hypothesis finish the proof.

theorem pure_triple_ext (M N T H : Modules S) {f g : (M ⊗ N) ⊗ T ⟶ H}
    (h : ∀ X x y z,
      f.val.app X (pureTensor (M ⊗ N) T X (pureTensor M N X x y) z) =
      g.val.app X (pureTensor (M ⊗ N) T X (pureTensor M N X x y) z)) : f = g
